# Course Catalogue

> Every course on the learning platform in play order, with its level, lessons, prerequisites and the commands it teaches, from `courses/<id>/course.md`.

Start one in any surface with `learn ID`; copy its lab into real bash with `bin/bashcrawl lab ID`. Writing a course: [authoring-courses.md](../authoring-courses.md).

| ID | Course | Level | Lessons | Requires | Summary |
|---|---|---|---:|---|---|
| `navigator` | Finding Your Way | beginner | 5 | — | pwd, ls, cd and paths: move through any filesystem with confidence. |
| `reading` | Reading the Runes | beginner | 4 | `navigator` | cat, head, tail, wc, nl and less: read any file without opening an editor. |
| `pipelines` | The Pipeline Forge | intermediate | 6 | `reading` | grep, sort, uniq, cut and the \| that joins them: answer real questions about real data. |
| `workshop` | The Artificer's Workshop | intermediate | 5 | `navigator` | mkdir, touch, cp, mv, rm and chmod: create, organise and protect files. |
| `shell-craft` | Words of Power | advanced | 5 | `pipelines`, `workshop` | Variables, arithmetic, aliases, globs, quoting and history: make the shell work for you. |
